name: @quickchatai/pi-quickreview
description: QuickReview for pi: /qcr-review (this branch, a PR, a branch or the uncommitted tree, in the background), /qcr-scan and /qcr-setup in your own pi session, each also a skill, on the same review core the QuickReview bot runs
//pi: pi loads exactly this: the one extension and the skills/ directory below (one skill per command). No prompts/ or themes/ directory exists at the package root (the frozen seeds ship under assets/), so pi's conventional discovery finds nothing else; tests/pi-plugin-install.test.ts proves it on the packed tarball.
//peerDependencies: Supplied by the running pi, never installed beside it. The pi range is the version gate's (src/plugin/versiongate.ts): the plugin registers no command on a pi outside it, and only versions the canaries ran on belong in it (`npm run canary:pi:range`).
